title: Corner Pricing Page Visual Design Spec
summary: Complete visual design spec for Corner's pricing page. 9 deliverables: plan cards (4 variations), comparison table, billing toggle, social proof bar, FAQ accordion, bottom CTA, mobile wireframes, OG image, responsive breakpoints. Bobby builds from this.
content:
Corner Pricing Page Visual Design Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For: Bobby (implementation) | Steve (spec source: pricing-page-spec.md) URL: corner.app/pricing Deliverables: 9

Design System (Page-Specific Tokens)

The pricing page follows the Corner "heaven" aesthetic: warm off-white, generous whitespace, premium feel. This is a marketing page, not the dashboard. No dark theme. Clean, confident, Apple-level polish.

Token Value Usage
bg-page #FAFAF8 Page background
bg-white #FFFFFF Card backgrounds, FAQ answers
bg-faq #F5F3F0 FAQ section background
bg-table-alt #FAFAF8 Alternating table rows
border-card #E8E5E0 Card borders
border-table #ECEAE6 Table cell borders
text-hero #111111 Hero headline, plan names
text-body #333333 Body text, descriptions
text-secondary #666666 Secondary text, meta
text-muted #999999 Tertiary info
accent-primary #E85D26 CTAs, Growth highlight, checkmarks
accent-primary-hover #D04F1E CTA hover
accent-primary-light rgba(232,93,38,0.08) Growth card background tint
accent-gold #C9A84C Enterprise subtle accent
cta-secondary-border #D1CCC4 Secondary CTA button border
check-included #E85D26 Included feature checkmark
check-excluded #CCCAC6 Excluded feature empty circle
shadow-card 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.03) Card shadows
shadow-card-hover 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) Card hover
shadow-growth 0 2px 8px rgba(232,93,38,0.08), 0 8px 32px rgba(232,93,38,0.06) Growth card

Typography

Element Font Size Weight Color Line-height
Page hero headline Syne 48px (desktop) / 32px (mobile) 800 text-hero 1.1
Page hero subheadline Space Grotesk 18px (desktop) / 16px (mobile) 400 text-secondary 1.5
Plan name Space Grotesk 20px 700 text-hero 1.2
Plan price number Syne 40px 800 text-hero 1.0
Plan price unit (/month) Space Grotesk 14px 400 text-muted 1.0
Plan description Space Grotesk 14px 400 text-secondary 1.5
Plan feature item Space Grotesk 14px 400 text-body 1.6
CTA button text Space Grotesk 14px 600 #FFFFFF (primary), text-body (secondary) 1.0
"Recommended" badge JetBrains Mono 10px 700 accent-primary 1.0
Billing toggle label Space Grotesk 14px 500 text-body 1.0
"Save 20%" badge JetBrains Mono 10px 700 accent-primary 1.0
Social proof text Space Grotesk 16px 400 text-secondary 1.5
Table category header Space Grotesk 14px 700 text-hero 1.4
Table feature name Space Grotesk 13px 400 text-body 1.4
Table feature value Space Grotesk 13px 500 text-body 1.4
Tooltip text Space Grotesk 12px 400 text-body 1.4
FAQ question Space Grotesk 16px 600 text-hero 1.4
FAQ answer Space Grotesk 15px 400 text-body 1.65
Bottom CTA headline Syne 36px (desktop) / 28px (mobile) 800 text-hero 1.15
Bottom CTA subheadline Space Grotesk 16px 400 text-secondary 1.5

Deliverable 1: Pricing Card Design (4 Variations)

Shared Card Structure

All 4 tiers share the same card skeleton:

Dimensions:

  • Width: equal flex (25% each on desktop, fills grid cell)
  • Min-height: 420px (content drives height, cards align via flexbox stretch)
  • Padding: 32px

Container:

  • Background: bg-white
  • Border: 1px solid border-card
  • Border-radius: 16px
  • Box-shadow: shadow-card
  • Display: flex, flex-direction: column

Content Stack (top to bottom):

  1. Plan Name + Badge Area (height: auto)

    • Plan name: Space Grotesk 700, 20px, text-hero
    • Badge area: 24px height reserved (only Growth shows badge)
    • Margin-bottom: 8px

  2. Price Block (height: auto)

    • Price number: Syne 800, 40px, text-hero
    • Dollar sign: Syne 800, 24px, text-hero (smaller, baseline-aligned to price number, -2px tracking)
    • "/month" suffix: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, text-muted, 4px left gap
    • Yearly price (when toggle is yearly): strike-through on monthly price, yearly equivalent shown below
    • Yearly equivalent: Space Grotesk 400, 12px, text-secondary, "billed annually" suffix
    • Margin-bottom: 4px

  3. Description (height: auto)

    • Space Grotesk 400, 14px, text-secondary, line-height 1.5
    • Max 2 lines
    • Margin-bottom: 20px

  4. CTA Button (height: 48px)

    • Full width
    • Border-radius: 10px
    • Font: Space Grotesk 600, 14px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.04em
    • Transition: all 200ms ease
    • Margin-bottom: 24px

  5. "Includes:" Label (height: auto)

    • Font: Space Grotesk 600, 11px, text-muted, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.1em
    • Margin-bottom: 12px

  6. Feature List (flex: 1, pushes CTA to consistent position across cards)

    • Each item: flex row, gap 10px, margin-bottom: 10px
    • Checkmark icon: 16px circle, accent-primary fill, white check inside (SVG)
    • Feature text: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, text-body, line-height 1.6

Variation 1: Starter (Standard)

  • Border: 1px solid border-card
  • Shadow: shadow-card
  • CTA style: SECONDARY
    • Background: transparent
    • Border: 1.5px solid cta-secondary-border
    • Color: text-body
    • Hover: background #F5F3F0, border-color #B8B3AB
  • No badge

Variation 2: Growth (Highlighted / Recommended)

THE card that grabs attention. Subtle but undeniable.

  • Border: 2px solid accent-primary (not 1px like others)
  • Shadow: shadow-growth
  • Background: bg-white with a very subtle gradient at the top:
    • Linear gradient from accent-primary-light (top 0px) to transparent (top 80px)
    • This gives the top of the card a barely-there warm orange glow
  • Scale: transform scale(1.02) relative to other cards. It's physically slightly larger. Subtle dominance.
  • CTA style: PRIMARY
    • Background: accent-primary
    • Color: #FFFFFF
    • Hover: background accent-primary-hover, translateY(-1px), shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(232,93,38,0.25)
  • "Recommended" Badge:
    • Position: above the plan name, left-aligned
    • Container: inline-flex, padding 4px 10px
    • Background: accent-primary at 10%
    • Border: 1px solid accent-primary at 20%
    • Border-radius: 6px
    • Text: JetBrains Mono 700, 10px, accent-primary, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em
    • Content: "RECOMMENDED" (not "Most Popular", this is a premium product)

Variation 3: Scale (Standard)

  • Same as Starter (standard card)
  • Border: 1px solid border-card
  • Shadow: shadow-card
  • CTA style: SECONDARY (same as Starter)
  • No badge

Variation 4: Enterprise (Distinguished)

  • Border: 1px solid border-card
  • Shadow: shadow-card
  • Background: #FCFBF9 (barely off-white, warm tint, distinguishes from other 3)
  • Price display: "Custom" in Syne 800, 40px, text-hero (no dollar sign, no /month)
  • Below price: "Let's talk about your needs." in Space Grotesk 400, 14px, text-secondary
  • CTA style: OUTLINED
    • Background: transparent
    • Border: 1.5px solid accent-gold
    • Color: accent-gold
    • Hover: background rgba(201,168,76,0.06), border-color #B89838
    • Text: "Contact Sales" (not "Start Free Trial")
  • Feature list items use accent-gold checkmarks instead of accent-primary

Hover State (All Cards)

  • Shadow: shadow-card-hover
  • Transform: translateY(-3px) (lifts slightly)
  • Transition: all 250ms ease
  • Growth card hover: keeps its extra shadow, adds slightly more lift translateY(-4px)

Deliverable 2: Feature Comparison Table Styling

Table Container

  • Width: 100% (max-width: 1120px, centered)
  • Border: 1px solid border-table
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Overflow: hidden
  • Background: bg-white
  • Box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)

Header Row (Sticky)

  • Position: sticky, top: 0
  • z-index: 10
  • Background: bg-white
  • Border-bottom: 2px solid border-table
  • Height: 64px

Header Cells (plan names):

  • Font: Space Grotesk 600, 14px, text-hero, centered
  • Growth column header: accent-primary color, small dot indicator below name
  • Width: first column (feature names) = 280px fixed. Remaining 4 columns = equal width.
  • Padding: 16px

Category Headers

  • Full-width row spanning all columns
  • Background: #F8F6F3
  • Padding: 12px 20px
  • Font: Space Grotesk 700, 14px, text-hero
  • Left border accent: 3px solid accent-primary (inside the cell, left side)
  • Collapsible on mobile (click to expand/collapse category)

Feature Rows

  • Alternating backgrounds: bg-white / bg-table-alt
  • Height: auto, min-height: 44px
  • Padding: 10px 20px

Feature Name Cell (left column):

  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, text-body
  • Vertical-align: middle
  • Display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 6px
  • If has tooltip: small "?" icon (12px circle, border-table border, text-muted fill, cursor: help)

Value Cells:

  • Text-align: center
  • Vertical-align: middle

Checkmark (included):

  • SVG circle: 20px diameter
  • Fill: accent-primary
  • White check icon inside: 10px, stroke-width 2
  • Alt-text: "Included"

Empty Circle (excluded):

  • SVG circle: 20px diameter, hollow
  • Stroke: check-excluded, 1.5px
  • Fill: transparent
  • Alt-text: "Not included"

Text Values (quantities like "3", "6", "10"):

  • Font: Space Grotesk 500, 13px, text-body
  • No circle, just the text centered

"Unlimited" text:

  • Font: Space Grotesk 500, 13px, accent-primary
  • Conveys premium

Tooltip Component

  • Trigger: hover on "?" icon (desktop) or tap (mobile)
  • Delay: 200ms before showing
  • Container: absolute positioned, above the trigger element
  • Background: text-hero (#111111)
  • Color: #FFFFFF
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 12px, line-height 1.4
  • Padding: 8px 12px
  • Border-radius: 6px
  • Max-width: 240px
  • Arrow: 6px triangle pointing down toward the trigger
  • Shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)
  • Fade in: 150ms ease
  • Dismiss: mouse leave or tap elsewhere

Growth Column Highlight

The Growth column gets a subtle visual lift throughout the table:

  • Header cell: accent-primary color text
  • Column cells: very subtle left+right border in accent-primary at 5% opacity
  • This creates a soft "highlighted column" stripe effect without being loud

Deliverable 3: Billing Toggle Component

Position

  • Centered horizontally, below the hero subheadline
  • Margin: 40px auto 48px auto (above the plan cards)

Toggle Design

      [ Monthly ]  [O----]  [ Yearly ]  [ Save 20% ]

Container:

  • Display: inline-flex, align-items: center, gap: 12px
  • Height: 40px

Labels:

  • Font: Space Grotesk 500, 14px
  • Active label: text-hero, font-weight 600
  • Inactive label: text-muted, font-weight 400
  • Transition: color 200ms ease, font-weight 200ms ease

Toggle Switch:

  • Width: 48px, height: 24px
  • Border-radius: 12px (fully rounded)
  • Background (monthly active): #D1CCC4 (neutral)
  • Background (yearly active): accent-primary
  • Transition: background 200ms ease

Toggle Knob:

  • Width: 20px, height: 20px
  • Border-radius: 50%
  • Background: #FFFFFF
  • Shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)
  • Position: 2px from left (monthly) or 26px from left (yearly)
  • Transition: left 200ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) (spring overshoot)

"Save 20%" Badge:

  • Visible only when monthly is active (incentive to switch to yearly)
  • When yearly is active: badge hides, prices show yearly amounts
  • Container: inline-flex, padding 4px 10px
  • Background: accent-primary at 10%
  • Border: 1px solid accent-primary at 20%
  • Border-radius: 20px (pill)
  • Text: JetBrains Mono 700, 10px, accent-primary, uppercase
  • Animation: when toggling to monthly, badge slides in from right (translateX(10px) to 0, 200ms)
  • When toggling to yearly, badge slides out (translateX(0) to translateX(10px) + opacity 0, 150ms)

Price Animation

When toggling monthly/yearly:

  • Price numbers count up or down (countUp animation, 300ms)
  • Old price briefly shows with a line-through before the new price resolves
  • Or: numbers flip like a mechanical counter (CSS @keyframes)
  • Simpler option: crossfade (opacity 0 > 1, 200ms) is also acceptable. Bobby's call on implementation complexity.

Accessibility

  • Toggle has aria-label: "Switch between monthly and yearly billing"
  • Toggle has role="switch" and aria-checked reflecting current state
  • Labels are clickable (click "Yearly" to activate yearly)

Deliverable 4: Social Proof Bar

Position

  • Between plan cards section and feature comparison table
  • Full width, centered content
  • Padding: 48px 0

Layout

  • Display: flex, flex-direction: column, align-items: center, gap: 16px

Content

Tagline:

  • "Trusted by businesses across Phoenix and beyond."
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, text-secondary
  • Text-align: center

Logo Row (when available):

  • Display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 40px, justify-content: center
  • Logos: grayscale, opacity 0.4, height: 28px (normalize all logos to same height)
  • Logo hover: opacity 0.7, grayscale removed (shows real color), transition 300ms
  • When no client logos yet: show "Join [X] businesses running on Corner." in Space Grotesk 500, 14px, text-muted

Testimonial (optional, below logos):

  • Max-width: 560px, centered
  • Quote text: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, text-body, line-height 1.6, italic
  • Opening quotation mark: Syne 800, 48px, accent-primary at 20%, position: absolute, offset top-left
  • Attribution: Space Grotesk 500, 14px, text-secondary
  • Format: "First Last, Title at Company"
  • Photo: 40px circle, right of attribution text
  • If no testimonial yet: omit this section entirely. Don't fake it.

Dividers

  • Thin lines (1px, border-card) above and below the social proof section
  • Width: 100px centered (decorative, not full-width)

Deliverable 5: FAQ Accordion

Section Container

  • Background: bg-faq (#F5F3F0)
  • Padding: 80px 0 (desktop) / 48px 16px (mobile)
  • Full width

Section Header

  • "Frequently Asked Questions"
  • Font: Syne 800, 28px (desktop) / 22px (mobile), text-hero
  • Text-align: center
  • Margin-bottom: 48px (desktop) / 32px (mobile)

Accordion Container

  • Max-width: 720px
  • Margin: 0 auto
  • Background: bg-white
  • Border: 1px solid border-card
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Overflow: hidden

Question Item

Collapsed:

  • Padding: 20px 24px
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid border-table (except last item)
  • Display: flex, align-items: center, justify-content: space-between
  • Cursor: pointer
  • Transition: background 150ms ease
  • Hover: background #FAFAF8

Question Text:

  • Font: Space Grotesk 600, 16px, text-hero
  • Line-height: 1.4
  • Flex: 1

Arrow Icon:

  • Lucide ChevronDown, 18px, text-muted
  • Transition: transform 250ms ease
  • When expanded: rotate(180deg)

Expanded:

  • Answer container slides down (max-height 0 to auto, 300ms ease)
  • Answer padding: 0 24px 20px 24px (no extra top padding, flows from question)
  • Answer text: Space Grotesk 400, 15px, text-body, line-height 1.65
  • Answer links: accent-primary, underline on hover

First Item Default

  • First FAQ item is expanded by default (reduces bounce rate, immediately provides value)

Keyboard Accessibility

  • Enter/Space on focused question: toggles open/close
  • Each question is a button with aria-expanded
  • Answer container has role="region" and aria-labelledby pointing to the question

Deliverable 6: Bottom CTA Section

Container

  • Full width
  • Background: bg-page (#FAFAF8)
  • Padding: 100px 0 (desktop) / 64px 16px (mobile)
  • Text-align: center
  • Border-top: 1px solid border-card

Content Stack

  1. Headline: "See it for yourself."

    • Font: Syne 800, 36px (desktop) / 28px (mobile), text-hero
    • Margin-bottom: 12px

  2. Subheadline: "Your AI team is 2 minutes away. Free for 7 days. No setup required."

    • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, text-secondary
    • Max-width: 460px, margin: 0 auto
    • Line-height: 1.5
    • Margin-bottom: 32px

  3. Primary CTA Button:

    • Text: "Start Your Free Trial"
    • Width: auto, padding: 16px 40px
    • Height: 52px
    • Background: accent-primary
    • Color: #FFFFFF
    • Font: Space Grotesk 600, 15px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.04em
    • Border-radius: 12px
    • Shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(232,93,38,0.2)
    • Hover: background accent-primary-hover, translateY(-2px), shadow 0 4px 16px rgba(232,93,38,0.3)
    • Transition: all 200ms ease
    • Margin-bottom: 16px

  4. Secondary Link: "Or contact us for a demo"

    • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, text-muted
    • Text-decoration: underline on hover
    • Color: text-muted, hover: text-secondary
    • Cursor: pointer
    • Routes to /book

Decorative Element (Optional)

  • Below the CTA, very subtle: a small isometric office illustration fading to transparent
  • Max-height: 120px, opacity: 0.08
  • Purely atmospheric. If it adds loading weight, skip it.

Key Mobile Decisions:

  1. Card order: Growth FIRST (recommended card appears at top on mobile, not buried as second). Then Starter, Scale, Enterprise.
  2. Cards: Full width, stacked vertically, 16px gap between cards.
  3. Comparison table: Plan selector dropdown at top. Select one plan, see its features in a vertical list. No horizontal scroll (too cumbersome on 390px).
  4. Plan selector dropdown:
    • Height: 44px (touch target)
    • Border: 1px solid border-card
    • Border-radius: 8px
    • Background: bg-white
    • Font: Space Grotesk 500, 14px
    • Chevron indicator right side
  5. Feature list in mobile comparison:
    • Each feature is a row: feature name left, value right
    • Category headers: full-width, bold, collapsible
    • Checkmark/empty circle same as desktop but smaller (16px)
  6. FAQ: Same accordion, full width. Padding adjusts to 16px.
  7. CTA button: Full width on mobile (padding 16px, not 40px).

Tablet (768-1023px):

  1. Cards: 2x2 grid. Growth card in top-left (first position). 16px gap.
  2. Comparison table: Horizontal scroll with sticky left column (feature names).
  3. Everything else: Same as desktop, padding scales down proportionally.

Deliverable 9: Responsive Breakpoint Behaviors

Desktop (1024px+)

Section Behavior
Hero Centered text, 48px headline, 18px sub, 40px toggle margin
Plan Cards 4 cards side-by-side, equal width, 24px gap
Social Proof Centered, logos in row, 40px gap
Comparison Table Full 5-column table, sticky header, 280px feature column
FAQ 720px max-width centered, 80px section padding
Bottom CTA Centered, auto-width button, 100px padding

Tablet (768-1023px)

Section Change from Desktop
Hero 36px headline, 16px sub
Plan Cards 2x2 grid, Growth top-left. 16px gap. Cards min-width 320px.
Social Proof Same, logos may wrap to 2 rows
Comparison Table Horizontal scroll, sticky left column (feature names). Scroll indicator shadow on right edge.
FAQ Same max-width, 60px section padding
Bottom CTA Same, 80px padding

Mobile (390-767px)

Section Change from Desktop
Hero 32px headline, 16px sub, all left-aligned (not centered)
Plan Cards Full width stacked. Growth FIRST. 16px gap. 16px horizontal padding.
Social Proof Full width, logos stack to 2 rows or shrink
Comparison Table Plan selector dropdown + vertical feature list (one plan at a time). No horizontal scroll.
FAQ Full width, 16px padding, 48px section padding
Bottom CTA Full width button, 64px padding

Scroll Behavior

  • Smooth scroll when clicking "Compare plans" link in hero or cards
  • Scroll-margin-top: 80px on the comparison table anchor (accounts for sticky nav)

Nav Bar Behavior

  • Existing site nav: scroll-hide (hides when scrolling down, shows when scrolling up)
  • Glassmorphism: rgba(250,250,248,0.85), backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
  • Height: 56px
  • Contains: CORNER. logo, nav links, CTA

Section Spacing Summary

Section Transition Desktop Spacing Mobile Spacing
Nav to Hero 80px 48px
Hero to Toggle 40px 32px
Toggle to Plan Cards 48px 32px
Plan Cards to Social Proof 64px 48px
Social Proof to Comparison 64px 48px
Comparison to FAQ 80px 48px
FAQ to Bottom CTA 0px (CTA border-top serves as divider) 0px
Bottom CTA to Footer 80px 48px

Interactions Summary

Element Interaction Animation
Plan card Hover translateY(-3px), shadow increase, 250ms ease
Growth card Hover translateY(-4px), extra shadow, 250ms ease
CTA primary Hover darken bg, translateY(-1px), shadow grow, 200ms
CTA secondary Hover bg #F5F3F0, border darken, 200ms
Billing toggle Click knob slides 200ms spring, bg transitions, badge slides
Price numbers Toggle Count up/down or crossfade, 300ms
Tooltip Hover (200ms delay) Fade in 150ms
FAQ item Click Expand/collapse 300ms ease, arrow rotate 250ms
Comparison row Hover Subtle bg tint #F8F6F3, 100ms
Bottom CTA Hover translateY(-2px), shadow grow, 200ms
Social proof logos Hover opacity 0.4 > 0.7, grayscale off, 300ms

Scroll Reveal Animations

All sections use staggered scroll-reveal on first appearance:

Section Animation Trigger
Hero headline Fade up (translateY 20px > 0, opacity 0 > 1) Page load (immediate)
Hero subheadline Fade up, 100ms delay after headline Page load
Toggle Fade up, 200ms delay Page load
Plan cards Stagger fade up, 100ms between each card Intersection observer at 80%
Social proof Fade in Intersection observer at 80%

Accessibility Checklist

  • All text meets WCAG AA contrast against bg-page (#FAFAF8)
    • text-hero (#111) on bg-page: 14.5:1. Pass.
    • text-body (#333) on bg-page: 9.7:1. Pass.
    • text-secondary (#666) on bg-page: 5.1:1. Pass.
    • text-muted (#999) on bg-page: 2.8:1. FAIL for body text. OK for decorative.
    • accent-primary (#E85D26) on bg-white: 3.5:1. FAIL for small text. Use only for large elements (CTA buttons where text is white on orange: 4.2:1 at 14px bold = pass AA for large text).
  • CTA buttons: minimum 44px touch target
  • FAQ: keyboard navigable (Enter/Space to toggle)
  • Comparison table: proper th/td with scope attributes
  • Toggle: role="switch", aria-checked, clickable labels
  • Tooltips: keyboard-accessible (show on focus, not just hover)
  • Plan cards: keyboard navigable, focus ring visible
  • Skip navigation link for screen readers

The pricing page is the last thing someone sees before they become a customer. It needs to feel as premium as the product itself. Clean, warm, confident. No surprises. No tricks. "Your AI team. Pick your plan." Make it easy to say yes.
